title: Climb Mount Niitaka
substackTitle: Pearl Harbor, Part 2: Climb Mount Niitaka
subtitle: 30 November to 3 December 1941. A prince voices the navy's doubts, Tokyo decides on war, a coded signal sends the carriers on, and Japan's embassies begin to burn their codes.
coverCredit: Kaga steams through heavy North Pacific seas on the way to Pearl Harbor, early December 1941, with Zuikaku beyond. Frame from film shot aboard Akagi, found on Kiska in 1943. U.S. Navy, NHHC NH 75483, public domain.
synopsis: In four days Tokyo turns doubt into decision, and the carriers are told the date.
